newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Krasny Vyborzhets has H1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Krasny Vyborzhets has H1 loss.

text.p: Non-ferrous metals processor AO Krasny Vuborzhets had a pre-tax loss of four billion roubles in the first half of this year after a pre-tax profit of around 18 billion roubles in the same period last year, a company official said on Thursday.
The company produces rolled and alloyed non-ferrous metals.

Zoya Blagova, economy and finance director at Krasny Vyborzhets, told Reuters that the company's output of rolled non-ferrous metals fell to 7,000 tonnes in the first half of this year from 10,000 tonnes in January-June of 1995.
"In Russia, there is no real demand for our output, while the high cost price is eating away profits from export deals," Blagova said.
Workers of Krasny Vyborzhets hold the largest stake in the company, amounting to 30 percent of the capital of 350.6 million roubles.
Blagova said no other shareholders had stakes above 10 percent and the state did not own any shares.
Krasny Vyborzhets shares are quoted on the Russian Trading System at $0.370/0.660 per share. They were last traded at $0.584 on August 21.
